We are an OpenAI Select Partner, and the 2026 program year has brought a dedicated API organization and a ChatGPT workspace with Codex credits, valid for the full program year.

The workspace and credits fund testing the free 3D Studio connector in ChatGPT, customer proofs of concept, and live demos of 3D agents. The connector is live now and answers with 16 tools without asking for a key or an account. three.ws/openai
